    Simulate a snake game based on given movements.

    Args:
        board_size: Tuple (width, height) defining valid coordinate range [(0,0) to (width-1, height-1)]
        snake: List of (x, y) tuples where the head is first

        moves: List of movement directions ("UP", "DOWN", "LEFT", "RIGHT")

    Returns:
